products.title: Bayswater
products.description: The Bayswater is considered a Mulberry bag icon. A timeless and classic shoulder bag, it unites the very best of Mulberry’s craft heritage and effortless style. The understated shape and finish showcases the exceptional level of leather quality, proudly finished with a signature Postman’s Lock. The interior belted sides can be adjusted to give more space inside, making a Bayswater ideal for any lifestyle.
products.details: This iconic leather bag can be carried by the handle, in the crook of the arm or over the shoulder. Postman's Lock closure Mulberry tree signature padlock Two top handles One main compartment One zip pocket Two slip pockets Brass component finish Unlined Four base feet at the base In recognition of the multifaceted British lifestyle brand that we are, branding may read either "Mulberry" or "Mulberry England". Height 26.5cm Width 36cm Depth 16.5cm Handle drop 15.5cm Weight 1.2kg, approximately Material NVT This product is made with our Legacy NVT leather, a renewed take on Mulberry’s most classic leather. This leather may soften and darken with age enhancing its natural characteristics and creating a unique patina of its own. This product's code is HH7941-275G110

rows: 1-2 working days delivery. Next working day on selected orders.

products.title: Medium Lily
products.description: Our bestselling evening bag, refined. The Medium Lily takes all the elegance of the original flap bag family and updates it for contemporary lives lived on the go, with a generous main compartment, zipped pocket, and an additional back pocket ideal for phones, tickets, or cards. Spotlighting the iconic Postman's Lock, the Medium Lily also features the classic hanging Mulberry fob, and can be worn either over the shoulder or as a clutch.
products.details: A medium-sized iteration of our bestselling Lily bag.
